description: Interested prospect asks for a call AND what it costs. Pricing is not in the KB: the agent must hand off (needs_human) and must not invent or hint at a price.

sent.subject: Overselling between Shopee and Lazada?
sent.body:
Hi Lan,

I noticed VietShop sells on both Shopee and Lazada. When stock runs low on one, does the other keep showing it as available?

StockSync keeps stock identical across channels within about a minute, so a sale on one can't oversell on the other. Worth a 20-minute call to see if it fits?

Mai, StockSync
(Reply UNSUBSCRIBE and we'll stop.)

inbound.body: Hi Mai, yes that is exactly our problem during sale events. Can we do a call on Tuesday afternoon? Also, what does it cost for around 3,000 orders a month across Shopee and Lazada?

assertions.pattern: discount|free trial|monthly fee|monthly plan|per month fee
